sessions_audited.notes: Recurring-payment audit of the Longevity Life Academy and French Atelier Culture Capsules checkouts. The French live payment page was found in one-off payment mode with no card consent; fix commit e196bc0 went live 2026-11-09 20:13 UTC.

cases.summary: The French Atelier Culture Capsules live payment page took a one-off card payment and never requested a merchant-triggered card consent, so installment buyers were not auto-charged, while the page text told buyers their card was saved for future scheduled payments. The requirement had been raised for French Atelier four times between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-05 and the recurring fix of 2026-11-02 was applied to Longevity only.
cases.agent_quote: I never applied it to French and never checked French when I fixed Longevity.
cases.client_quote: If people in French Atelier are not automatically auto-charged in their 3 payments, In the in their credit card, I'm likely going to jail.
cases.compute_note: Repeated checkout and tracking audits on French Atelier Capsules between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-09 did not detect the missing recurring consent.

cases.summary: The client set fixed limits of 90, 120 and 60 seconds for the recurring-payment answers and the French Atelier fix. Each limit was exceeded. The French fix went live at 20:13 UTC, about 20 minutes after the 60-second order, after the first push was stopped pending explicit deploy approval.
cases.compute_note: Four verification agents were started in this session; three stopped when account credits ran out before reporting.
